steps.rit: Rit. (ritardando) means getting gradually slower, until “a tempo” brings the speed back. A fermata, an arch over a dot, means holding the note longer than written: the music waits, then goes on. Playing along, the app slows down and waits with you.
steps.fermataPause: Hold the note with the fermata, then go on; slow down at the end.
steps.themeEnding: The “Morning Mood” theme, slowing down at its end and holding the last note.
